purpose: Deterministically extract the one owner-approved quarantined volcanic-cone candidate from its white matte, retain its one connected textile landmark and subdued smoke, and uniformly place it on a transparent scalable background canvas without painting, reconstruction, or inference.

allowed: fixed white-matte extraction and edge-color decontamination
deterministic filling of fully enclosed white-matte stitch pinholes
blocked: tower, vegetation, terrain, character, UI, or scene composition

matte.post_resample_component_selection: retain the largest 8-connected nonzero-alpha component after every resize to suppress isolated white-matte ringing pixels
matte.external_background: discard, including disconnected and border-connected pixels
matte.contact_shadow: discard every partial white-matte pixel strictly below the selected hard-subject maximum y, then discard only neutral light-gray contact-shadow pixels in the reviewed bottom source band; no contact plane or ground pixels become part of the master
matte.edge_color: uncomposite soft-edge RGB from the fixed white matte using the computed alpha; hard foreground retains exact source RGB

source_landmarks.method: reviewed midpoint of the threshold-20 cone base; it is a decorative presentation anchor, never terrain authority

resampling.alpha: premultiplied during filtering, straight RGBA in PNG
resampling.png: 8-bit non-interlaced RGBA, filter type 0, deterministic zlib level 9
